summary: Team Reptile's Jet Set Radio-inspired graffiti traversal game, mixing inline skating, skateboarding, BMX, cel-shaded city exploration, and music-driven crew battles.

entries.title: Bomb Rush Cyberfunk

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows at the highest stable settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings

primary.why: Bomb Rush Cyberfunk released digitally for Windows and Nintendo Switch on 18 August 2023, then for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S on 1 September 2023, with physical editions later in 2023 for Switch, PS5, and Xbox One/Series X. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings; use Switch for portable play or PS5/Xbox Series X/S for console access, with physical editions useful for preservation.

all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity and most flexible route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster; physical editions exist for Switch, PS5, and Xbox One/Series X. Hyperfunk is announced as a follow-up but is not a released entry yet.
